item.title: If an AI bubble bursts, could it speed up AI-related job losses?
item.description: Past recessions suggest downturns can accelerate automation, raising concerns about a double blow for workers.

item.title: New federal voucher program: can it help public schools? Democrats divided
item.description: The new scholarship tax credit program could help public school families pay for some educational services, but advocates worry it may cause more harm.

item.title: DOJ files voting crime charges against 28; TikTok disregarded staff child safety warnings
item.description: As Election Day approaches, the Justice Department has charged 28 individuals in California with voting crimes. Meanwhile, TikTok staff raised child safety concerns that were reportedly ignored.
